lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: The Sighing Wood, at the edge of winter. Burnt|by Shadow, frozen by Ice, and not dead yet.
lines.text: The Sighing Wood, at the edge of winter. Burnt by Shadow, frozen by Ice, and not dead yet.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: Five glades still remember being green.|Break the rime, plant, and keep them warm.
lines.text: Five glades still remember being green. Break the rime, plant, and keep them warm.

lines.speaker: maelis
lines.subtitle: Torvald holds the west. His glass warden|holds the east. They're both very tidy.
lines.text: Torvald holds the west. His glass warden holds the east. They're both very tidy.

lines.speaker: messenger
lines.subtitle: My lady, the hollow by the camp is|frosted, but it's still breathing.
lines.text: My lady, the hollow by the camp... it's frosted, but it's... it's still breathing.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: Grow. Slowly, if you must. Just grow.
lines.text: Grow. Slowly, if you must. Just grow.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: Green, in the Sighing Wood.|For the first time since the fire.
lines.text: Green, in the Sighing Wood. For the first time since the fire.

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.subtitle: They're planting. Go and put the frost back.|Gently. Nothing here should grow strong.
lines.text: They're planting. Go and put the frost back. Gently. Nothing here should grow strong.

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.subtitle: Ysolde. Torvald asked me to keep this|wood quiet. I keep what I'm asked to keep.
lines.text: Ysolde. Torvald asked me to keep this wood quiet. I keep what I'm asked to keep.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: You froze a grave, Aldra. I've come to open it.
lines.text: You froze a grave, Aldra. I've come to open it.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: They broke it. Then we plant it again.|Roots don't count how often.
lines.text: They broke it. Then we plant it again. Roots don't count how often.

lines.speaker: maelis
lines.subtitle: Tall enough for birds now.|Big ones, with thorns.
lines.text: Tall enough for birds now. Big ones, with thorns.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: The Last Heartwood.|You held on all winter, didn't you?
lines.text: The Last Heartwood. You held on all winter, didn't you?

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Aldra. Let her plant. We will|see what the frost thinks of it.
lines.text: Aldra. Let her plant. We will see what the frost thinks of it.

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.subtitle: Cracked. Not broken. I'll be|back before your seedlings are.
lines.text: Cracked. Not broken. I'll be back before your seedlings are.

lines.speaker: hush
lines.subtitle: One more night, Ysolde.|The Bishop pays for every one.
lines.text: One more night, Ysolde. The Bishop pays for every one.

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.subtitle: Enough green. This wood is|ours by treaty, and by winter.
lines.text: Enough green. This wood is ours by treaty, and by winter.

lines.speaker: maelis
lines.subtitle: Her glass is sand now.|She'll have to sulk somewhere warmer.
lines.text: Her glass is sand now. She'll have to sulk somewhere warmer.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Ysolde. You were always the patient one.|Why can you not wait for spring?
lines.text: Ysolde. You were always the patient one. Why can you not wait for spring?

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: Because you froze the spring, Torvald.|Somebody has to go and get it.
lines.text: Because you froze the spring, Torvald. Somebody has to go and get it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: Five glades, green at once.|Deep under the ash, something old turns over.
lines.text: Five glades, green at once. Deep under the ash, something old turns over.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: Hold them. All of them. Just a little longer.
lines.text: Hold them. All of them. Just a little longer.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Aldra. Look. A shoot,|in the ash. After all of that.
lines.text: Aldra. Look. A shoot, in the ash. After all of that.

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.subtitle: It's a weed, Torvald.
lines.text: It's a weed, Torvald.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: We were all weeds once. Pull back.
lines.text: We were all weeds once. Pull back.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: You see, Maelis? It always comes back.
lines.text: You see, Maelis? It always comes back.

lines.speaker: maelis
lines.subtitle: Mm. And it brought you a present.
lines.text: Mm. And it brought you a present.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: The wood can, now. Thank you, Vessa.
lines.text: The wood can, now. Thank you, Vessa.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: Under the frost, very slowly,|the Sighing Wood began to breathe again.
lines.text: Under the frost, very slowly, the Sighing Wood began to breathe again.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: The wood... will remember...
lines.text: The wood... will remember...

lines.speaker: maelis
lines.subtitle: The new Heartwood's fallen.|The wood has nothing left to grow from.
lines.text: The new Heartwood's fallen. The wood has nothing left to grow from.
